box.highlights: Sayville 48, Harborfields 7: Kyle Messina rushed for 158 yards and two touchdowns on 13 carries for Sayville in Suffolk III. Patrick Coan completed 11 of 15 passes for 184 yards and three touchdowns and Dylan Kent made an interception. Jack Weiss scored a 5-yard touchdown run and added the extra point kick for Harborfields.

Sayville 40, Islip 6: Kyle Messina had 28 carries for 204 yards and four touchdowns and had an interception to lead Sayville (2-0) in Suffolk III. Thomas McCann caught eight passes for 119 yards and totaled seven tackles, including four solo tackles. Mikey Sands had two sacks and eight tackles, including six solo tackles and two for a loss. Alex Labella had two sacks and six tackles, including four solo tackles for a loss. Brady Nash ran for a TD for Islip (1-1).

Sayville 28, Comsewogue 10: Kyle Messina ran 13 times for 172 yards and a 45-yard touchdown to lead visiting Sayville (3-0) in Suffolk III. Patrick Coan completed 14 passes for 232 yards and three TDs. Tomas McCann caught seven passes for 127 yards and two TDs and Dylan Kent caught seven passes for 105 yards and a score. Mikey Sands had 13 tackles, including two for a loss. Donovan Bartollotta had an interception and a fumble recovery and Luke Neugebauer added an interception. Lucass Shannon had a rushing TD for Comsewogue (1-2).

Sayville 49, Westhampton 10: Patrick Coan completed 19 of 26 passes for 310 yards and four touchdowns to lead host Sayville (4-0) in Suffolk III. Dylan Kent had four catches for 95 yards and two touchdowns. Donovan Bartolotta had two catches for 53 yards and two touchdowns. Tomas McCann had six catches for 63 yards. Kyle Messina rushed for 64 yards and a touchdown on 11 carries. Messina also had a 30-yard fumble return touchdown, an interception and six tackles. Keith Kolar had a forced fumble, Mikey Sands had eight tackles and two tackles for loss and Tristan Vitale had a 17-yard touchdown run. Finn Drake completed 10 of 20 passes for 109 yards and a touchdown and Patrick Fay had four catches for 49 yards and a touchdown for Westhampton (1-3).

Sayville 57, Kings Park 21: Patrick Coan completed 10 of 13 passes for 239 yards and two touchdowns and added three carries for 86 yards and three TDs to lead visiting Sayville (5-0) in Suffolk III. Kyle Messina had nine carries for 114 yards and two TDs and Tristan Vitale added a 73-yard TD run. Tomas McCann caught three passes for 101 yards and a TD and Dylan Kent added three catches for 61 yards and a score. Kevin Vasquez ran for two touchdowns for Kings Park (0-5).
Sayville 28, Half Hollow Hills West 21: Kyle Messina had 28 carries for 200 yards and two TDs and Mikey Sands had 14 tackles, including seven solo and one for a loss for Sayville in Suffolk III.

Sayville 54, Eastport-South Manor 10: Patrick Coan completed 8 of 11 passes for 183 yards and four touchdowns to lead visiting Sayville (7-0) in Suffolk III. Kyle Messina had four carries for 139 yards and a touchdown and caught two passes for 79 yards and a score. Tommy McCann, Donovan Bartolotta and Mikey Sands each added a TD catch. Tristan Vitale and Stash Chorowski each added a rushing TD. Sands had 12 tackles, including two for a loss and Dylan Kent returned an interception 33 yards for a TD. McCann and Messinaeach had eight tackles. Joe Hershey ran for a TD for Eastport-South Manor (3-4).

Sayville 49, Hauppauge 0: Kyle Messina rushed for 100 yards on seven carries and two touchdowns to lead Sayville (8-0) in Suffolk III. According to coach Sands, Messina now has a career total of 89 touchdowns. Patrick Coan completed five of his seven passes for 88 yards and two touchdowns. Coan also rushed for 54 yards on three carries. Mongiello rushed for 53 yards and a touchdown on eight carries. Brady Dolan had a 50 yard fumble return forced by Ryan Linker.  Jack Dolan led the team in tackles with nine and Mikey Sands had seven tackles a sack. Alex LaBella had six tackles.  Javen Taff also a added a sack as the Sayville Defense led up 45 yards of offense.

Sayville 59, Eastport-South Manor 13: Kyle Messina led team in rushing with nine carries and 159 yards, scoring three touchdowns on the way to a Suffolk III qualifying win for No. 1 Sayville over No. 8 Eastport-South Manor Friday night. Patrick Coan turned all three of his passes into touchdowns, finishing with 84 yards. Tommy McCann had two catches for 77 yards and two TDs, and Mikey Sands added a 7-yard touchdown reception. Sands also had seven tackles, two TFLs, a fumble recovery and a 35-yard pick-six. Tristan Vitale added the final score, finishing with three carries for 78 yards and a score. He also forced a safety. Dylan Kent and Donovan Bartolotta both had an interception. Ryan Linker led the team in tackles with eight. John Metz and Joey Hershey added rushing scores for Eastport-South Manor (3-6). Sayville (9-0) will host No. 4 Westhampton in the semifinal round on Friday, Nov. 15, at 6 p.m.
Top-seeded Sayville (10-0) beat No. 4 Westhampton (6-4) in the Suffolk III semifinals.

Sayville 42, Half Hollow Hills West 35
Kyle Messina rushed for 264 yards and four touchdowns on 36 carries as top-seeded Sayville defeated Half Hollow Hills West, 42-35 in the Suffolk Division III final. It is a Suffolk record 16th title for undefeated Sayville (11-0). Patrick Coan completed 11 of 23 passes for 198 yards and a touchdown for the Golden Flashes. Joseph Filardi completed 21 of 35 passes for 370 yards and five touchdowns for Hills West. Anthony Raio had 14 receptions for 283 yards and three touchdowns for Hills West. The finished the season at 9-2.
Garden City defeated Sayville in the Long Island Class III championship.
